verification_handoff.current_account_verification: Inspect; do not remove or claim during preparation
verification_handoff.risk: Destination verification can release an existing Pages binding; an already verified domain requires a coordinated release
sequence: Inspect both accounts and record current Pages, TLS, DNS and verification settings
Confirm DNS/provider access without changing records or completing domain verification
Transfer the repository only during the separately approved maintenance window
Coordinate any organization verification release and personal verification in that window
Confirm the moved repository custom-domain binding, Pages permissions and TLS
Apply the approved www CNAME change and verify root, www and app support/legal routes

prerequisites: Review existing account-level verification and the GitHub-provided TXT challenge without completing a claim early
Confirm destination GitHub Pages publishing permissions and Actions workflow eligibility
Confirm Pages custom domain and TLS binding before the DNS change
Approve the repository transfer and maintenance window
preserve: Existing apex A/AAAA/ALIAS records unless separately reviewed
Canonical origin and app legal/support routes
Existing Pages workflow and app configuration
Xpounder-com/neuralint-platform ownership, Azure trust and runtime settings
